messages:
alex: heads up — PR #43321 touches routing/fallback + kv cache header ordering. planning to merge Fri 10:00 PT if no blockers. need runtime + platform + infra + sec eyes. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/43321

sam: looking now. rough LOC? any perf test runs?

alex: small (~85 LOC). ran unit tests and perf microbench; no regression locally. CI flaky on one test (unrelated). perf run file: `bench/fallback_latency.log`

lee (platform): can do platform review. will check rollout flags, telemetry tags, and canary plan.

ashley (infra): assigning infra to review networking + autoscaler impacts. ping me if you need capacity reservation for the canary window.

nina (security): quick question — are there any new auth headers or token usages? if so I need a short threat-model note. otherwise I can do a fast pass tomorrow morning.

sam: saw a potential NPE in the kv invalidation branch when shard==nil, will try a repro. if confirmed I can push a 1-line guard.

alex: thanks — if sam has the quickfix we can squash and rerun CI. @maria-sre, can you reserve a canary slot Fri 11:00 PT for ~30m?

maria-sre: can do, reserved canary-3 11:00-11:45 PT. pls add runbook steps + rollback key in the PR description.

sam: pushed a tiny fix -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abc123 (3 lines)

lee (platform): LGTM from platform side. left 2 tiny nits about comment phrasing and a telemetry tag. rollout flag and metrics look good.

ashley (infra): infra ok — no capacity or autoscaler issues observed. double-check eviction thresholds during canary.

nina (security): security quick-pass done assuming no new tokens. left a comment asking for an explicit note in the PR about header usage.

alex: plan: sam merges after CI green + squash, canary Fri 11:00 PT. monitor `fallback_rate` and p90 latency. fallback to model-variant B if anomaly. thx all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI status: all checks queued -> running -> some flaky test rerun in progress. will post final status in thread.
